# Apron Design dependency

`index.css` is the unmodified published stylesheet from
[`@apron-design/react@26.0.5`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@apron-design/react/v/26.0.5).
The upstream MIT license is retained in `LICENSE.txt`.

The home page and three privacy policy pages use Apron's button, capsule tab
and card styles with semantic HTML and a local shared interaction script.
The website does not require React or a build step. Theme variables in
`styles.css` map Apron's colors to the existing TrafArch palette, and
typography uses the existing local HarmonyOS Sans assets.

Reference: [Apron Design](https://github.com/apron-design), especially its
React component tokens and design principles. The independent preview page
also retains a link to the shared site styles and interactions.
